title: Make loot-filter ExportPanel read artifacts with the Result form, not fetchArtifacts
body:
## Summary
The loot-filter ExportPanel hydrates its lifecycle through the lossy fetchArtifacts, so a failed GET renders as lifecycle planned; the fetchArtifacts doc names /status views as its consumers, but ExportPanel is the only one.

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/labArtifactClient.ts:62-71 says the lossy wrapper is "Kept for read-only consumers (the /status views)" and "Anything that RENDERS not produced must use the Result form". The only caller is src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_inventory/loot-filter/ExportPanel.tsx:53, which renders deriveLifecycle([]) = planned on a dead server. Fixed: ExportPanel uses fetchArtifactsResult and shows unknown + retry on error; the wrapper is then dead and can go, or its doc names the real caller.

## Flow
- server down -> open loot filter export
- fetchArtifacts folds the 500 into []
- lifecycle reads planned, inviting a re-generate over server truth

## Expected impact
Loot-filter operators stop seeing a fabricated planned state on a server failure. Could break: ExportPanel tests that mock fetchArtifacts.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a failed read stops rendering as not produced
Before: 1 consumer of the lossy wrapper; failed GET -> planned (code read)
After: predicted 0 consumers; failed GET -> error state
Method: simulation - the fix is in loot-filter (outside this context), so no gate was run here
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: ExportPanel test: fetch mock returns ok:false -> lifecycle not planned, error shown (red before, green after)

title: Report a finished batch drain whose gates all stayed deferred
body:
## Summary
drainProblem treats a batch where every gate ran but stayed deferred as clean, so the UE drain lane reports idle and the tab title Done.

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/drainLaneModel.ts:35-42 flags errored, locked, ran-nothing and failed>0, never deferred. src/components/layout-lab/batchDrainModel.ts:52-56 documents deferred as gates that RAN but could not decide (judge outage, unregistered UE test), and src/components/layout-lab/entityDrainOutcome.ts:87 prints "N still deferred" for the entity scope. A batch of 20 planned gates (ran 20, deferred 20, passed 0) leaves no attention in the header. Fixed: drainProblem returns "N of M gates still deferred" when deferred > 0 and passed+failed < ran.

## Flow
- Matrix batch drain over a catalog whose UE tests are not registered
- runner returns ran 20 deferred 20
- drainLane -> lease idle label; tab title (Done)

## Expected impact
The operator sees a drain that decided nothing as needing attention. Could break: tabAttention tests that pin (Done) for this case.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - a drain that decided nothing is not reported as clean
Before: summary {ran:20, deferred:20, passed:0, failed:0} -> drainProblem null (code walk)
After: predicted non-null "20 of 20 gates still deferred"
Method: simulation - walked drainProblem on the summary shape; whether deferral is attention or a softer note is a product call
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: drainLaneModel unit test: deferred-only summary -> attention state

title: Surface a failed canon hydrate instead of silently keeping the seed rules
body:
## Summary
canonStore.hydrate sets hydrated:true on a failed GET and keeps the shipped seed, so the lab shows seed canon with no sign the DB rules were never read.

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/canonStore.ts:47-51: `if (r.ok && r.data.length) set({ rules, hydrated: true }) else set({ hydrated: true })`. A 500 and an empty table are the same state and the error is dropped. Dispatches read the DB (upsert doc, src/components/layout-lab/canonStore.ts:15-17), so the canon list and produce prompts can disagree with no signal. Distinct from the recorded canonStore:49 stale-race deviation. Fixed: a hydrateError field set on !r.ok, rendered by the canon view with a Retry.

## Flow
- server down -> open the canon view
- hydrate fails, hydrated:true, rules = seed
- canon list shows seed laws as if they were the DB

## Expected impact
Operators know when the canon on screen is the offline seed. Could break: CanonView tests that assert no alert.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a failed read is visible
Before: failed GET -> no error field, hydrated:true (code read)
After: predicted hydrateError set and rendered
Method: simulation - code walk; needs a CanonView render to decide where the error surfaces
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: canonStore test: tryApiFetch mocked ok:false -> hydrateError non-null (red before)

title: Scope the canon drift review error to the profile it failed on
body:
## Summary
canonStore.reviewError is one global string, so a failed adopt/keep on one profile is shown in every profile CanonDriftPanel.

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/canonStore.ts:38-42 sets reviewError for any review act; src/components/layout-lab/CanonDriftPanel.tsx:73 renders it in each mounted panel regardless of profileId. Same class as the reset/refresh failures keyed by entity (08bfc921, 4b7566fb). Fixed: key the error by the profile the act ran on and render it only where it matches.

## Flow
- adopt shipped on profile A -> 403
- open profile B drift review
- B shows the A failure as its own

## Expected impact
A review failure reads only where it happened. Could break: CanonDriftPanel tests reading reviewError.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - an error is attributed to its subject
Before: 1 global reviewError for N profile panels
After: predicted keyed, 1 panel
Method: simulation - walked store + panel
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: CanonDriftPanel test: failed adopt on profile A, render profile B -> no alert

title: Key the combat-lab and lanes reads by source/game like useBuildHealth
body:
## Summary
useCombatLab and useLanesBoard keep the previous source or game read across a key change, and on a failed first read of the new key show the old data as merely stale.

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/game/gameHomeBuildHealthData.ts:30-46 keys its state by gameId#lane#attempt so a key change reads loading. src/components/layout-lab/game/combat/combatLabData.ts:27-44 and src/components/layout-lab/game/gameHomeLanesData.ts:20-41 do not: a switch to a failing source renders the previous source tables under "Showing the last read; the latest poll failed". The fix needs care: src/components/layout-lab/game/combat/combatLabRoom.tsx:36 renders the source picker from d.sources, so a keyed loading/error state would hide the picker; keep sources while keying tables.

## Flow
- combat lab -> source picker -> a lane whose read fails
- setRead keeps prev ok data + staleError
- tables of the previous source shown for the new pick

## Expected impact
A read always belongs to the selected source. Could break: the picker vanishing while a new source loads.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no cross-key bleed
Before: 1 of 3 sibling readers keyed (build health)
After: predicted 3 of 3
Method: simulation - read the three hooks; tables carry their own source caption, which partly mitigates
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: combatLabRoom test: source A ok, switch to B with ok:false -> no A tables, picker still present

title: Key the refresh in-flight flag by entity like its report
body:
## Summary
useBaseline.refreshing is instance-scoped, so a refresh in flight on one entity shows its in-flight state on the next.

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/Baseline/useBaseline.ts:72 refreshing is a plain boolean; the report and error were keyed in 4b7566fb but the flag was left. Twin of the already-carded reset in-flight flag (catalog-browser-ui "Key the Reset in-flight flag by entity like its failure") - build both together.

## Flow
- refresh item-1 (slow)
- switch to item-2
- item-2 refresh control reads refreshing

## Expected impact
Controls reflect only the open entity. Could break: nothing beyond the label.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - in-flight state belongs to its entity
Before: refreshing shown on item-2 while the item-1 refresh is in flight
After: predicted not shown
Method: simulation - the Baseline.refreshScope.test.tsx harness would decide it
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: extend Baseline.refreshScope.test.tsx: refresh button enabled on item-2 while item-1 is in flight

title: Reattach the labCheckerContext JSDoc that sits on canonProfileInStore
body:
## Summary
The doc block for labCheckerContext sits above canonProfileInStore, so the exported labCheckerContext has no doc and canonProfileInStore has two.

## Description
src/components/layout-lab/labCheckerContext.ts:96-108: "The same context, read from the live store snapshots ... verdicts is optional" is followed by a second doc block and canonProfileInStore; labCheckerContext follows undocumented. Hover docs for the write-through context builder describe nothing.

## Flow
- hover labCheckerContext in an editor
- no doc; hover canonProfileInStore shows the other function doc

## Expected impact
Readers of the grading path see the right doc. Nothing can break.

## Evaluation
Claim: other - doc attached to its symbol
Before: 1 orphaned doc block
After: 0
Method: probe - read the file; no gate sees JSDoc placement short of a TS-API check
Result: better
Gate: none
